## Change

Describe the behavior change and how it affects existing data products.

## Validation

Record the commands, environment, and actual results. Distinguish synthetic
evidence from real instrument calibration and on-sky validation.

## Reproducibility

Identify any schema, calibration, uncertainty, or provenance changes. Inspect
the diff for credentials, proprietary material, and unauthorized observations.

- [ ] I tested the affected installation or workflow.
- [ ] I used shareable synthetic fixtures or documented approval for any data included.
